spans.s:
mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be taken, to be carried or conducted.
E.
णी to take, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Leading, conducting, one who guides or leads, &c.
m. (-ता)
1 A master, an owner.
2 A guide.
E.
णी to lead, aff. तृच्.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं)
A leader, a guide, one who guides or leads.
n. (-त्रं)
1 The eye.
2 The root of a tree.
3 Bleached or wove silk.
4 A car, a carriage.
5 The string of a churning rope.
6 An enema pipe.
mn. (-त्रः-त्रं)
Any tubular vessel.
f. (-त्री)
1 A river.
2 The goddess LAKṢMĪ.
E.
णी to guide or gain, Uṇādi aff. ष्ट्रन्, fem. aff. ङीष्.

n. (-जं)
A tear.
E.
नेत्र, and ज born.

m. (-दः)
An eyelid.
E.
नेत्र the eye, छद to cover, aff. अच्.

mfn. (न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
As far as to the eye, up to the eye.
m. (-न्तः)
The outer angle of the eye.
E.
नेत्र, and पर्य्यन्त limitative.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 A cat.
2 The ball of the eye.
E.
नेत्र the eye, and पिण्ड a ball of flesh, &c.

The moon.
E.
नेत्र an eye, and योनि the vulva; being covered with marks resembling that organ, through the curse of GAUTAMA, whose wife he had attempted to debauch; the sage afterwards relenting, changed these disgraceful marks on the body of the deity to as many eyes.

n. (-नं)
Collyrium.
E.
नेत्र, and रञ्जन delighting.

m. (-गः)
Any disease of the eye.
E.
नेच, and रोग disease.

n. (-स्त्रं)
A veil over the eye.
E.
नेत्र, and वस्त्र clothes.

m. (-यः)
Ophthalmia, &c.
E.
नेत्र, and आमय sickness.

m. (-म्बुः)
A tear.
E.
नेत्र an eye, and अम्बु water.

n. (-वं)
Any pleasing or beautiful object.
E.
नेत्र, and उत्सव festival.

n. (-धं)
1 Green sulphate of iron considered as a collyrium.
2 Collyrium in general.
f. (-धी)
A drug, commonly कोंगा.
E.
नेत्र the eye, and औषध a medicament.
